# Repository AI Instructions

`AGENTS.md` is mandatory.

Read the applicable rules before coding. Inspect neighboring code before adding abstractions. Prefer the simplest design that satisfies correctness, security, performance, scalability, and maintainability.

The architecture is feature-first vertical slices inside a modular monolith.

Reject speculative layers, catch-all folders, unnecessary packages, sync-over-async, unbounded queries, hidden I/O, and abstractions without a concrete use case.
